title: Each trial removes its Docker networks when it ends, and spent address pools are a trial-host fault
description: With the Docker CLI stubbed, a trial whose check services create a preview network removes it when the trial passes, fails or is cancelled; the loop's leftovers sweep removes a preview-trial network no container uses, keeps one a running container uses, and the daily leftovers report counts the removed networks. A trial whose network Docker refuses with "all predefined address pools have been fully subnetted" records a trial-host fault naming the preview networks on the host: the head is neither refused nor reworked and stays queued for another trial, and the loop raises one attention line.

steps.name: Trial networks are removed when trials end and swept when left, and spent address pools are a trial-host fault
